messages:
DeployBot: [ALERT] canary-deploy:kv-cache-v2 -> 10% traffic. Health check failing: memory_pressure on 3 nodes in us-west-2a. auto-rollback started.
Alyssa (eng): seeing it in dashboards — p95 mem spiking on canary pods to ~13.2GB (limit 14G). requests with long context (>8k) look suspicious.
Dmitri SRE: confirmed. heap growth trace attached (gzipped). error rate on /generate up from 0.3% -> 2.6% over last 7m on canary. Not yet seen in stable pool.
Amy SRE: auto-rollback attempted but DeployBot reports partial failure: some pods removed, but traffic still routed to a subset that kept the new config. suspect rollout controller didn't respect the rollout label.
Jules Ops: can we flip the feature flag to drain? Which flag name?
Alyssa (eng): flag is `rdw.kv_cache.v2_enable`. It's on for service:inference, env:prod; variation: canary.
Dmitri SRE: suggest immediate kill-switch: set flag to off for canary hosts. Also scale down canary replicas to zero as safe fallback.
Oncall Li: doing `ld` change now (LaunchDarkly).
Jules Ops: while Li toggles, I'm preparing commands to drain ips and cordon nodes. Patch below:
```
# drain canary deployment
kubectl -n inference patch deploy canary-kv-cache --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":0}]'
kubectl -n inference get pods -l rollout=canary -o wide
```
Alyssa (eng): note: cache flush may be necessary after drain, otherwise old KV entries may be read by fallback code.
DeployBot: [INFO] auto-rollback step 2 failed on controller: mismatch label `rollout-id`. Manual intervention required.
Oncall Li: flag toggle done: `rdw.kv_cache.v2_enable` set -> false for rollout id `kv-v2-2026-03-15-canary`. Confirmed by LaunchDarkly UI.
Dmitri SRE: good. Starting manual scale down. Running drain command for pods on hosts with high rss: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-122-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Amy SRE: I'm patching in a temporary nginx rate-limit to slow long-context requests to 60s to avoid memory amplification. Patch snippet: `replace:  limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=burst:10m rate=1r/s`
Jules Ops: drain took ~30s on 2 nodes; scheduling restarts. Traffic % to canary dropped from 10% -> 0.4% in 4m.
Kate PM: customer impact? any Affected customers or SLO breaches?
Dmitri SRE: quick assessment: ~0.5% of total requests experienced elevated latency; 12 customers saw >10% of their requests routed to canary during window, of which 3 observed increased error rates. No persistent data corruption.
Alyssa (eng): running smoke tests against stable now. `curl -sS https://inference.api/v1/health` -> OK. `python scripts/smoke_long_context.py --iters 50` all pass on stable.
DeployBot: [INFO] canary deployment scaled to 0 replicas. Rollout marked paused.
Amy SRE: cleaning up leftover KV cache dirs on drained nodes: `sudo rm -rf /var/lib/rdw/cache/kv-v2/*` then restart agent. Doing on two nodes.
Oncall Li: leaving traffic pin in stable and setting a cleanup ticket for follow-up. Handoff to SRE for postmortem and changelog.
Jules Ops: created INC-2145 with notes and attached logs. Will also coordinate a short blast on #statuspage if PM approves.
Kate PM: please draft short incident note: affected small subset; mitigated by feature-flag toggle and manual drain; follow-up: revert config to kv-cache-v1 and run canary tests with memory profiling.
Dmitri SRE: plan: revert rollout manifest that introduced `kv-cache-v2` changes, add additional memguard probe for long-context requests, and add a stricter rollout label check to the controller.
Alyssa (eng): adding test harness to reproduce long-context mem behavior. Will tag SRE when ready.
Amy SRE: verification: 30m after mitigation error rates back to baseline, CPU/memory stable. Leaving monitoring alerts to lower severity.
DeployBot: [RESOLVED] incident auto-rollback failed -> manual rollback complete, severity downgraded.
Oncall Li: handoff to overnight oncall: @Dmitri SRE will own the follow-up. Any objections?
Dmitri SRE: ack. I'll own the postmortem, assigning action items.
Kate PM: thanks all. I'll notify affected customers with summary at 21:10 UTC.
Alyssa (eng): quick lessons: QA long-context perf tests on every cache change, add rollout label validation, and make auto-rollback block until rollback label propagation confirmed.
Jules Ops: closing the loop: update INC-2145 with mitigation steps, patch links, and next-run checklist. :thumbsup:
